description: L. Supulawathie de Silva v. P. Gnanasiri de Silva and Others L. Supulawathie de Silva v. P. Gnanasiri de Silva and Others View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: L. Supulawathie de Silva v. P. Gnanasiri de Silva and Others L. Supulawathie de Silva v. P. Gnanasiri de Silva and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court judgement dismissing her action for declaration of title, ejectment and damages, relying on prescriptive title. Held - Evidence did not establish continuous and adverse possession required for the prescriptive period; mere possession was insufficient to establish prescription. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
